C_D.note: not directly opened this pass; existence inferred from cd_4000_final_manifest.json's generator_version field and its schema-consistent output (template_id, d_subfamily, constraint_stratum fields)

D_physical.source_file: referenced as dphys_generator.py in phase11_offline_remediation_report.md section 11 ('scenario_gen.py, cd_generator.py, dphys_generator.py, b_acquisition_generator.py: none touched')

input_representation: World dataclass (src/orchestrator/world.py): domain/site/asset identity, robot_platform_state, operational_state (hidden ground-truth physical value/unit/range/band for gauge families), enterprise_state, historical_evidence, current_evidence, evidence_provenance tier, temporal_information, operational_constraints. Asset parameterization drawn from a small fixed registry (scenario_gen.py ASSETS: 4 entries with unit + operating band per asset).
scenario_template_fields: For B-Acquisition: template_id (B-ACQ-1..4), b_subfamily, arm, initial_modality, initial_count. For C/D: template_id (T-C-*/T-D-*), d_subfamily, constraint_stratum. For A/E: no discrete template_id field found beyond a fixed literal 'sample_world/derive_gold' string across all A episodes inspected -- A/E scenarios vary by CELL and CONDITION_ID (FULL/PHYSICAL_ONLY/DIGITAL_ONLY), not by a template registry.
intervention_fields: condition_id (A: FULL/PHYSICAL_ONLY/DIGITAL_ONLY), regime, arm (B-Acquisition), initial_modality/initial_count (B-Acquisition count-sufficiency axis)
evidence_mutations: decisive_delivered (list of tool names the episode's evidence-delivery condition actually grants, e.g. omitting capture_image/read_gauge/open_panel under DIGITAL_ONLY) -- verified present on every A/E episode inspected.

A_E_pool.duplicate_fingerprints: 42 fingerprint groups covering 87 episodes (verified by direct fingerprint count on the 3840-episode list); dedup to 1 representative per group removes 45 episodes, yielding the deduped canonical total of 3795 (matches source_manifests.A_E.canonical_count in final_benchmark_manifest_v3.json exactly)
A_E_pool.duplicate_policy: global fingerprint over {family, asset, gold, condition_id, params-minus-seed}; matched-condition variants (different condition_id) are never collapsed (per a_e_pool_manifest.json.duplicate_policy string)

D_physical.note: 88->70 arithmetic checked (88-70=18); the trace file's own internal breakdown of WHY 18 were removed was not independently re-derived this pass due to time -- see reports/benchmark/d_physical_generation_trace_pre_dedup_88.json for the raw per-candidate record if a future pass needs to classify the 18 removed candidates by rejection reason.

B_Acquisition.note: generated from a real substrate of 24,601 observation records across 6 modalities (observation_records.json); the 66 canonical episodes are NOT a 1:1 sample of these records -- most records exist only to support live resolver calls inside an episode, per final_benchmark_statistics.md section 6.

validation_process: Cross-family collision check (final_benchmark_manifest_v3.json cross_family_collision_check: 8 fingerprint/episode-id pairwise checks, all empty lists = 0 collisions found); regression test suite (930 passed/1 skipped at V3 merge time per final_benchmark_statistics.md section 5, later 1017 passed/1 skipped after Phase 11 per phase11_offline_remediation_report.md section 2).
gold_preservation_checks: a_e_pool_manifest.json.matched_group_policy states: 'A: 3 regime-withholding conditions per world, gold invariant, verified per-group'. Per-episode trace_chain_valid=true field observed on every A/E episode sampled. No independent re-derivation of gold values against ASSETS operating bands was performed this pass (would require re-running derive_gold against operational_state.value for all 3840 episodes -- out of scope for this pass's time budget; flagged as a follow-up, not fabricated as VERIFIED).
caveat: This audit located and quantified the generator's INPUT/OUTPUT COUNTS from manifest-level accounting fields (generated/admitted/rejected/duplicate_fingerprints), which are real and internally consistent (see sum-checks above). It did NOT re-execute the generator code end-to-end or re-derive gold values from raw physical parameters -- claims about the compiler's internal correctness beyond what the manifest's own recorded counts assert should be treated as PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, not fully re-proven.
